Container.Name: football-watchability
Container.Overview:
Live football, ranked by how good each game is right now.
Polls ESPN's public scoreboard and scores every in-progress game on closeness weighted by lateness, endgame drama, recent win-probability swings, upset magnitude against the pregame closing line, and scoring pace. Also ranks the week ahead by how much each matchup is worth planning around.
Needs no API keys. The board keeps nothing on disk; only the optional push notifications need a volume.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Host port for the board and its JSON API. The container always listens on 8787. Change this if another container already publishes that port on the host. Put it behind a reverse proxy or a tunnel rather than exposing it directly.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Must be US Eastern or close to it. The poller asks ESPN for yesterday-through-today, and those day boundaries decide whether a game running past midnight is still visible.

Config.Name: Live poll interval (ms)
Config.Description: How often to refresh while games are live.

Config.Name: Idle poll interval (ms)
Config.Description: How often to poll when nothing is live. The poller also wakes just after the next kickoff regardless.

Config.Name: Schedule lookahead (days)
Config.Description: How far ahead the planning list reaches.

Config.Name: Recap window (hours)
Config.Description: How far back the just-finished list reaches.

Config.Name: Notification storage
Config.Description: Holds the push keypair and subscriptions. Only needed for alerts; the board itself keeps nothing.

Config.Name: Notification directory
Config.Description: Where to keep push keys and subscriptions. Leave as /config to match the path above. Alerts stay off unless this points at a real volume.

Config.Name: Notification contact
Config.Description: A mailto: address sent to push services with each delivery, so they can reach you about problems.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the server runs as. 99 is the Unraid default owner of appdata; the container takes ownership of the notification directory on start.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the server runs as. 100 is the Unraid default for appdata.
